scope_notes: Only public commands and SDK outputs were inspected in an empty owned document on dedicated private Xvfb.
Bounded commands run at idle outside RunPythonScript Undo. Raw seed histories, command histories, terminal events, EndCommand, post-script, external Undo and Redo states are retained.

Mode and factor defaults are seeded by completed public reference commands on a disposable point before source construction. Cancellation and zero-reference memory are subsequently tested without injecting observed defaults.
Individual tight bounding centers determine translations independently of groups. Complete source geometry, weights, knots, domains and mesh records are compared within absolute epsilon 1e-9.

Copies retain source selection, object order, attribute and geometry UserText and original overlapping groups. Displayed grips alone are excluded; selected whole parents preserve grip picks and copied grip displays.
Native Add of a NURBS surface wraps it into a Brep and drops the input surface geometry UserText. Baseline snapshots retain the resulting empty dictionary; attribute UserText is preserved.
Numeric negative factors use their magnitude and numeric zero is rejected. Off-axis 1D references use unsigned projected ratios; 2D and 3D references use Euclidean distance ratios.
Numeric getter shape follows startup mode. Changing 3D to 1D before numeric input finishes without a direction or edit; changing 1D to 2D or 3D still requests a direction.

Zero-length second references finish successfully without an edit, save Mode and retain the previous positive factor. Trailing idle Cancel separately clears selection; EndCommand and post-script states are both retained.

Application tests make 57 incremental and 42 complete-invocation replays, including repeated copies, canceled defaults and Undo/Redo. Closed cancellation and repeated-input workflows are replayed incrementally only.

Real mouse picks, native preview appearance, reference distance locks, calculator expressions, all trimmed/subcomponent sources, cross-viewport input, restart persistence, performance and full parity remain unverified. Repeated-reference copies and command-first pick order/history have additional evidence in scale-positions-input-provenance.json.

This original capture retains its exact probe source under capture_sources/scale_positions_20261004.py. Later public preference and point-witness queries use the extended current probe. A 57-case refresh is retained as diagnostic evidence under observations/scale_positions_defaults_diagnostic.json because a standalone 1D point has inconsistent native Undo behavior between captures. The original 57 regression and 99 application replays are not replaced by that diagnostic.
